title: lens.config.json
description: Optional configuration file for soroban-lens. Keys mirror the LENS_* environment variables. Precedence: command-line flag > environment variable > config file > built-in default.

rpcUrl.description: Soroban RPC endpoint URL. Mirrors LENS_RPC_URL.

networkPassphrase.description: Stellar network passphrase used to build and sign transactions. Mirrors LENS_NETWORK_PASSPHRASE.

contractId.description: Default contract ID to operate on when a command does not receive one explicitly. Mirrors LENS_CONTRACT_ID.

contracts.description: List of contracts to index or inspect in a single deployment. Mirrors LENS_CONTRACTS (comma-separated).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with every RPC request. Mirrors LENS_HEADERS (JSON object).

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed RPC request. Mirrors LENS_RETRIES.

retryDelayMs.description: Base delay in milliseconds between retries (exponential backoff). Mirrors LENS_RETRY_DELAY_MS.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Mirrors LENS_TIMEOUT_MS.

output.description: Output format for command results. Mirrors LENS_OUTPUT.

configPath.description: Path to an alternate config file. Mirrors LENS_CONFIG. When unset, ./lens.config.json is used if present.
